All tests pass, including the two new ones.

Added a `remind` command (`node src/cli.js remind`) that lists any habits not yet marked done today, or "All habits done for today!" if none are left — no new dependencies, follows existing patterns, plus tests and doc updates.

One thing to decide: this only shows reminders when you run the command yourself. Options if you want more automatic nagging:
1. **Keep as-is** — manual, on-demand check (what I built).
2. Auto-run `remind` output at the end of `list`, so you see it every time you check habits.
3. A shell one-liner in the README for wiring `remind` into cron/a shell startup file for real "nag me" behavior (still zero new deps, just docs).

My pick: option 1 for now, since 2 changes `list`'s existing output shape and 3 is easy to add later if you want it.
